ai_type.name: Flenserite
ai_type.description:
This AI has a Flenser in its Praetorian Guard at the beginning of the game, and some new ships designed to slice through your 防御.
It has exceptional border aggression, and also prefer CPAs to Waves (which are infrequent but strong).
<color=#ffa132>Not recommended without a 尖塔-Tier ally or two due to the strength of the Flenser.</color>

ai_type.name: Ametor
ai_type.description:
This AI gets a Mothership in it's Praetorian Guard at game start, and also shares ships from the Flenserite. For those who find the Flenser a bit excessive.
It has exceptional border aggression, and also prefer CPAs to Waves (which are infrequent but strong). Overall a bit weaker than the Flenserite.

ai_type.name: Miskatonic
ai_type.description:
The AI has allied itself with Lovecraftian horrors intent on shattering reality, alongside many other factions.
They focus on on cross planet attacks through normal space. Be prepared for a horrifying battle!

ai_type.name: Shadowen
ai_type.description:
This AI has a Ravenous Shadow in its Praetorian Guard at the beginning of the game, and a variety of other powerful Shadow Ships.
This AI focuses more on heavily defending its planets with turrets and guard posts.

ai_type.name: Lernean
ai_type.description:
Uses a number of Hydra style units. Also gets additional Orbital Mass Drivers and Ion Cannons.
Their waves come with Hydra Beachheading ships.

ai_type.name: Bandersnatch
ai_type.description:
Gets units from all the Sidekick Mod AI Types, and likes to focus your command stations.
This AI Type works very similarly to the scarier Sidekick AI Types (Miskatonic et al), but it's significantly nerfed from them. So you can still see the new goodies without as many challenges.

ai_type.name: Chivalric
ai_type.description:
This kindhearted AI prefers to leave your 旗舰 till last.
If you get frustrated with your 旗舰 getting crippled, this AI is for you.

ai_type.name: Deepstriker
ai_type.description: This AI's 霸主 will always have the AI Reserves help it regardless of whether it is in Deepstrike

ai_type.name: JubJubBird
ai_type.description:
Beware the Jub Jub Bird! This is the Jabberwock, but also has ships from Forge of Empires. This might be harder than the Jabberwock.
This may be the hardest AI type in the game.

ai_type.name: Wraith
ai_type.description:
This AI type uses a variety of different ship types in their sub-fleets. They use 天灾 in the 守望者 舰队, 奈祖尔 in the Border Aggression and 圣殿骑士 in the Praetorian Guard.
In addition, they have a particularly powerful Hunter 舰队 focused on 隐形 ships.

ai_type.name: Wanderer_DysonSidekick
ai_type.description:
This AI type has all its Bastion Worlds on Nomad Planets, and uses a wide variety of units.
Has an emphasis on waves in the early game especially.

ai_type.name: Kzinti
ai_type.description:
This AI uses ships from the 无敌舰队 Empire. Has pretty powerful waves.
It's possibly that the Difficulty should be Brutal, some feedback would be great.

ai_type.name: Tiberian
ai_type.description: This AI uses ships infused with 泰德瑞安; they often spawn weaker ships when destroyed, leading to protracted battles. Has powerful waves

ai_type.name: TurretMaster
ai_type.description:
Is an excessive fan of turrets.
On higher difficulties, this AI type will trigger the 'too many turrets' warnings; but isn't that what you signed up for?

ai_type.name: Hateful
ai_type.description:
Haters gotta hate! This AI type extensively features players least favourite AI ships, along with other nasty surprises.
You will hate this AI type or your money back.
Thanks to a number of Discord folks for ideas, including Lord of Nothing, CRCGamer and The Grand Mugwump

ai_type.name: Huntrix
ai_type.description: This AI has an especially powerful Hunter 舰队. It is intended to be paired with the Hunter Difficulty 'Zerg Rush'; to use that, you will need to disable 'Universal Difficulty' and set the 守望者 and Hunter difficulties manually.
